sn29.7:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn29.7:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn29.7:2.1: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī
sn29.7:2.5: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn29.7:2.6: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn29.7:2.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
